Add items, discount and shipping columns to the monthly export

Dana could not approve the monthly export: each order showed only its total,
so the total could not be checked. The export now appends the items, discount
and shipping in euros after the existing columns, so the column positions the
accountant's spreadsheet reads are unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
